name: AO3400A
description: 30V N-channel logic-level enhancement trench MOSFET in SOT-23, very low on-resistance (~18 mohm typ at Vgs=10V). Low threshold (0.65-1.45V) lets it be fully driven from 2.5-4.5V logic, so it is common on breakout/driver modules. Low-side load switch and PWM/motor/LED driver.

pins.name: G
pins.description: gate; logic-level, fully enhanced at Vgs=4.5V

pins.name: D
pins.description: drain; single pin opposite the two-pin side, thermally tied to PCB copper

extra.Rds_on: 32 mohm max at Vgs=4.5V (18 mohm typ at Vgs=10V)

typical_application: Low-side load switch and PWM control (motor, LED, solenoid drivers) on logic-level outputs; common on hobbyist breakout modules.
gotchas: the 5.7A rating is bonded to the die; real continuous current is limited by SOT-23 dissipation (1.4W at 25C) and PCB copper - far lower without adequate copper
pulsed Idm is rated to 30A but only as short pulses, not continuous
Vgs absolute max is only +/-12V (tighter than the +/-20V of most parts); watch ringing in fast switching
high junction-to-ambient thermal resistance; derate current significantly at elevated ambient temperature
